snippet.title: I added footstooling to Melee…
snippet.description:
I added footstools from Brawl to Super Smash Bros. Melee! Now you can step on your opponents head which allows for early kills offstage or hype combo extensions.

Thanks to Sushi for making the Hitbox Extensions gecko code, which allows for additional hitstun and hitlag, and making meteors non-cancellable.

Download:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Uhf0zfxGf0I6byiivHZzWiAvUiLwiEpF/view?usp=sharing
